tool_input.command:
cat > .tmp_insert.py << 'EOF'
import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

df = pd.read_csv("data/prediction_log.csv")
df["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(df["ts"], utc=True)
df["prediction"] = df["prediction"].astype("float64")
print("rows:", len(df), "range:", df.ts.min(), df.ts.max())

fg = fs.get_feature_group("prediction_log", version=1)
fg.insert(df, write_options={"wait_for_job": True})
print("INSERT_DONE")
EOF
mkdir -p .tmp && python .tmp_insert.py 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Insert prediction log via SDK with parsed timestamps
